description_short.value: Mobile network operator providing voice, data and mobile money services across Ghana.
description_short.source: Written by us from the Scancom PLC 2024 Annual Report and FY2025 results

description_full.value: Scancom PLC, which trades as MTN Ghana, runs a nationwide mobile network. Most of its revenue comes from voice calls, mobile data, SMS, interconnect and roaming, with smaller amounts from handset and accessory sales. Its subsidiary MobileMoney Ltd operates the MoMo platform, which lets customers send money, pay bills and make payments from a mobile wallet. The company had about 31.2 million mobile subscribers at the end of 2025. It was incorporated in 1994, became a public company in 2016 and listed on the Ghana Stock Exchange in September 2018. Its ultimate parent is MTN Group Limited of South Africa.

description_short.value: Ghanaian universal bank serving retail, commercial and corporate customers, with investment banking and mobile money arms.
description_short.source: Written by us from the GCB Bank PLC summary financial statements for 2025 (GSE PR 084/2026)

description_full.value: GCB Bank PLC holds a universal banking licence in Ghana. It takes deposits and lends to retail, commercial, business and corporate customers, and runs a treasury business. Its subsidiary GCB Capital Ltd provides investment banking services, and G-Money Financial Services Limited runs its mobile money service. The bank was converted to a public company in 1994 and has been listed on the Ghana Stock Exchange since May 1996.
